### Observed differences

- In the earlier window, activities A14, A15 and A20 were not observed in any of the 200 traces; in the later window they appear in about 29, 41 and 30 in 100 traces respectively (58, 82 and 59 of 200). No trace contains more than one of them — all three pairs have zero co-occurrence — so together they cover essentially every later trace, one per trace. [OCC013, OCC014, OCC019, REL001, REL002, REL006]
- In the earlier window the segment A22 → A23 → A24 was rigid: A22 was followed directly by A23 in every observed transition, and A23 was followed directly by A24 in every observed transition. In the later window, A22 leads directly to A23 in only about 44 in 100 of its outgoing transitions and to one of the new activities in about 56 in 100; A23 leads directly to A24 in about 57 in 100 and to a new activity in about 44 in 100. [DIR018, DIR019]
- The new activities lead only to A23 or A24: A14 about 53 vs 47 in 100, A15 about 57 vs 43, A20 about 58 vs 42. [DIR010, DIR011, DIR016]
- Step distances grew by exactly one step: A22 to A23 is now two steps apart in about 56 in 100 traces (previously always one), A23 to A24 two steps in about 44 in 100 (previously always one), and A22 to A24 three steps in about 995 in 1000 later traces (previously always two). [LAG001, LAG002, LAG003]
- Each new activity always executes after A22 and before A24 (for example, A15 co-occurs with A22 in 41 in 100 traces and is always after it, and always runs before A24). Relative to A23 the order is mixed: A14 precedes A23 in about 16 in 100 traces and follows it in about 14 in 100, and A15 and A20 show the same two-way split. [REL007, REL009, REL004, REL008, REL011]
- The new activities sit near the middle of the trace (mean relative position about 0.51 for all three). [POS001, POS002, POS003]
- Away from this segment, the branch after A37 shifted: transitions from A37 to A39 rose from about 46 to 56 in 100, A38's participation fell from about 62 to 56 in 100 traces while A39's rose from about 57 to 67 in 100. [DIR029, OCC027, OCC028, OCC029]
- Smaller successor-share shifts appear around A01, A03 and A05 (for example, A01 → A05 fell from about 42 to 23 in 100 while A01 → A03 rose from about 28 to 42 in 100). [DIR001, DIR003, DIR005]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

In the later window, one extra activity is inserted into the previously fixed A22 → A23 → A24 sequence in almost every trace: exactly one of the mutually exclusive activities A14, A15 or A20, placed either directly after A22 (before A23) or directly after A23 (before A24). Before, this segment was always the two consecutive steps A22 → A23 → A24; in the later window it spans three steps in about 995 in 1000 traces, with the insertion after A22 in roughly 56 in 100 cases and after A23 in roughly 44 in 100. [OCC013, OCC014, OCC019, DIR018, DIR019, LAG001, LAG002, LAG003]

The support is direct and consistent: the successor profiles of A22 and A23 changed from a single successor each to four; the new activities' successors are exactly A23 and A24; all three pairwise step distances grew by exactly one step; and the order constraints — always after A22, always before A24, mixed against A23 — match an insertion into the segment rather than a reordering of existing steps. Participation rising from zero to 29–41 in 100 traces with zero co-occurrence between the three matches one insertion per trace. [DIR018, DIR019, DIR010, DIR011, DIR016, LAG001, LAG002, LAG003, REL004, REL005, REL007, REL009, REL001, REL002, REL006]

Limitations: the evidence shows only that A14, A15 and A20 were unobserved earlier, so it cannot distinguish genuinely new steps from existing activities being renamed or relocated into this segment, and it cannot show whether the choice among the three activities or between the two insertion points follows case characteristics. No screening baseline was provided, so the judgement rests on the directness and coherence of the relational evidence rather than a comparison against a chance expectation. [OCC013, OCC014, OCC019]

Other differences: a shift of flow from the A38 branch towards the A39/A40 branch after A37, and minor successor-share redistributions around A01/A03/A05; neither forms part of the main hypothesis. [DIR029, OCC027, OCC028, OCC029, DIR001, DIR003, DIR005]
